clues.text: Two days before Passover, the chief priests and elders met in this high priest's courtyard to plot Jesus' arrest.
Once Jesus was arrested, He was led to this high priest's house, where the scribes and elders had gathered.
He and Annas held the high priesthood when the word of God came to John in the wilderness.
Fearing the Romans would take their nation, the Sanhedrin heard this high priest say one man should die for the people.
Annas, to whom Jesus was first brought after His arrest, was the father-in-law of this high priest.
In the early morning, Jesus was led away from this high priest's presence into the Praetorium to face Pilate.
This high priest put Jesus under oath to say if He was the Christ, then tore his clothes, crying blasphemy.
